login_intro: Use your work email address and password.
login_code_hint: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login_code_failed: That code is incorrect. Please enter the current code.
login_offline: The server can't be reached right now.
login_limited: Too many failed attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.
share_offer_hint: Only accept this if you shared it yourself.
mail_pick: Select a mail on the left.
mail_empty_folder_hint: {count} mails will be deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
mail_empty_folder_hint_one: 1 mail will be deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
mail_spam_marked: Marked as spam. Similar mail will go to spam from now on.
mail_spam_unmarked: Moved to Inbox. Similar mail will get through from now on.
mail_shared_mailbox_hint: All members of {address} can see and handle this mail.
mail_check_confirmed: Sender verified: this mail really comes from {domain}.
mail_check_failed: Sender not verified: the check for {domain} failed.
mail_check_unproven: Unverified: {domain} has not set up sender verification. This is common for small companies.
mail_check_internal: Not checked: this mail didn't arrive over the internet, for example because it came from a colleague or from a migration.
mail_warn_own_domain: Caution: this mail claims to be from {domain} but came from outside. It probably isn't from your colleagues.
mail_warn_not_confirmed: Caution: the sender {domain} could not be verified because the check failed. This mail may be forged.
mail_warn_reply_to: Replies go to {replyTo}, not to the sender {from}. Check this before sharing invoices or bank details.
mail_attachment_forgotten_hint: The text says “{word}”, but nothing is attached.
mail_recipients_missing: Please add at least one recipient.
contacts_pick: Select a contact on the left.
contacts_no_mails: No mail with this contact yet.
settings_signature_details_hint: For the company signature: a line whose detail stays empty here is left out there.
settings_photo_hint: Your colleagues see your photo in chat, on calls, on tasks and next to your mail.
photo_not_image: That isn't an image that can be used as a photo.
settings_vacation_hint: Anyone who writes to you gets this reply once.
settings_vacation_message_placeholder: Thank you for your message. I'm out of the office until … For urgent matters …
rules_hint: Rules sort new mail as soon as it arrives. They run on the server, so they work even when Kontext is closed. They are applied from top to bottom.
rules_empty: No rules yet. For example: move mail from your tax advisor to the “Tax advisor” folder, or mark newsletters as read.
rules_action_forward_hint: The mail also stays here. A mail is forwarded at most once.
rules_problem_condition: Please fill in at least one condition.
rules_problem_action: Please choose what should happen to the mail.
rules_problem_address: Please enter a valid address to forward to.
rules_saved: Rule saved. It applies to new mail.
rules_saved_applied: Rule saved and applied to {count} mails in your Inbox.
rules_saved_applied_one: Rule saved and applied to one mail in your Inbox.
rules_saved_none: Rule saved. No mail in your Inbox matches yet.
rules_apply_existing: Also apply to mail already in the Inbox
rules_apply_hint: Moves and flags the matching mail once now; nothing is forwarded.
rules_mailbox_hint: Apply to all new mail to this mailbox, for everyone who uses it.
settings_password_hint: Applies to Kontext, your phone and mail apps.
settings_password_mismatch: The two new passwords don't match.
settings_2fa_hint: In addition to your password, Kontext asks for a code from an authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password).
settings_2fa_on: Every time you sign in, Kontext also asks for the code from your app.
settings_2fa_off: Your account is protected by your password only.
settings_2fa_disable_confirm: To turn it off, enter your password and the current code from the authenticator app.
settings_2fa_step_scan: Scan the QR code with the authenticator app.
settings_2fa_step_code: Enter the code shown and your password.
settings_2fa_qr: QR code for the authenticator app
availability_conflict_me: You are busy at this time.
availability_all_free: Everyone is free at this time.
availability_no_suggestion: No common free time in the next two weeks.
availability_note: People who don't share their calendar appear as free. External attendees aren't taken into account.
calendar_event_end_before_start: The end is before the start.
calendar_agenda_empty: No events in the next 30 days.
calendar_repeat_custom: Repeats on a custom rule; it stays as it is.
calendar_repeat_end_invalid: The last day is before the start.
contacts_book_delete_confirm: Delete address book “{name}” with all its contacts?
sharing_hint: View: see and call. Edit: also create, change and delete. Colleagues find the address book under “Shared with me”.
sharing_hint_calendar: Availability only: see when you're busy, without titles. View: see events. Edit: also create, move and delete. Colleagues find shared calendars under “Shared with me”.
sharing_everyone_hint: See when you're busy, without titles or details.
sharing_include_availability_hint: Events from this calendar count as busy. Turn off for a private calendar.
calendar_delete_confirm: Delete calendar “{name}” with all its events?
calendar_holidays_hint: Creates a calendar of its own with the public holidays of this year and the next, all-day and shown as free. Adding them again later fills in what is missing.
calendar_holidays_none: The public holidays are already in the calendar.
calendar_subscriptions_hint: Add a calendar by its address (iCal, webcal), e.g. school holidays, the waste collection or a supplier's dates. Kontext fetches it again every six hours; it does not count for availability.
calendar_subscription_remove_confirm: End the subscription “{name}”? The calendar and its events are deleted.
calendar_import_hint: Take appointments over from an iCalendar file (.ics) into a calendar, such as an export from Google, Outlook or Apple. What is already there (same UID) is skipped; attendees get no message.
calendar_import_unreadable: The file cannot be read as a calendar.
contacts_group_name_missing: Please enter a name for the group.
contacts_vcard_book: Address book for import and export
contacts_other_info: People you've exchanged mail with who aren't in any address book. Read from your recent mail.
contacts_cleanup_none: All good: no duplicate contacts and nothing to fix.
contacts_duplicates_info: These contacts seem to be the same person. Merging keeps one contact with all addresses, numbers and notes; groups point to it.
notifications_empty: All caught up: no new emails, tasks, invitations or events for today.
notifications_device_hint: New emails, chat messages, tasks for you and task reminders, even when Kontext is closed. Reminders 15 minutes before events while Kontext is open.
notifications_device_denied: Your browser is blocking notifications for Kontext. Allow them in your browser’s site settings.
notifications_unsupported: This browser can’t show notifications. On iPhone this works once Kontext is added to the Home Screen.
push_offer_hint: Get notified about new emails, chat messages, tasks and calls, even when Kontext is closed. You can change this anytime in the bell menu or under Settings → Appearance.
install_offer_title: Kontext as an app on your phone
install_offer_hint: Its own icon on the Home Screen, full screen without the browser bar, notifications and the unread email count on the icon.
install_offer_apple_open: Then open Kontext from the icon on your Home Screen
install_offer_apple_more: Can’t see it? Long-press the address bar (newer iOS versions) or tap “•••”.
shortcuts_hint: Just press the key while no input field is active.
settings_language_hint: Applies to this device. Kontext reloads when you switch.
search_empty: Nothing found. Tip: single words, from:name, has:attachment, in:info@. Press ? for all shortcuts.
company_forbidden: Company admin is only available to accounts with the “Company admin” permission.
company_employees_hint: Create accounts, reset passwords and block access. Applies to Kontext, phones and email apps.
company_availability_hint: Everyone can see when colleagues are busy, without titles or details. New employees get this automatically; anyone can turn it off again for their calendars.
company_admin_self: You can’t give up your own permission; another admin has to do that.
company_aliases_hint: Emails to these addresses end up in the same inbox.
company_password_reset_confirm: Generate a new password? {name} will be signed out everywhere.
company_code_reset_hint: For a lost phone: afterward {name} signs in with a password only and sets up the code again.
company_deactivate_confirm: {name} will no longer be able to sign in anywhere. Emails to the address will still arrive.
company_password_hint: Give it to {name} in person. It is only shown now; it can be changed under Settings → Password and security.
company_mailboxes_hint: All members see a shared mailbox like info@ under “Mailboxes”; they read, reply and send as this address.
company_access_hint: “Read only”: can see the emails but can’t move, delete or reply to them as this address.
company_vacation_hint: For example during illness: anyone who emails {name} gets this reply once.
company_vacation_departed: {name} has left. New emails are answered and forwarded by the offboarding; if you restore access, the out of office and rules apply again.
company_signature_hint: One signature for everybody. Kontext fills in [Name] and [E-Mail] per sender, e.g. “Anna Weber” and “info@…”; [Telefon], [Mobil], [Position] and [Abteilung] each person enters under Settings → Profile – a line whose detail is missing is left out. New employees get it automatically.
company_signature_apply_confirm: This replaces all employees’ signatures, including ones they changed themselves.
company_offboarding_hint: Access is blocked, nothing is deleted: emails and mailbox are kept (retention obligation).
company_handover_hint: Sees the mailbox under “Mailboxes” and can do everything in it except send as this address.
company_offboarding_text: Thank you for your message. {name} is no longer with us.
company_offboarding_confirm: {name} will be blocked and signed out everywhere. Continue?
company_migration_hint: Import emails, contacts and events: from Gmail, GMX, WEB.DE and others via “Connect mailbox”, from Outlook as a .pst file (File → Open & Export → Import/Export), contacts and calendars from the Google export as .vcf and .ics. Duplicates are skipped, so a migration can safely be repeated.
company_migration_upload_keep_open: Please keep this window open until the file has finished uploading.
company_sync_hint_gmail: Gmail needs an app password: in your Google Account, turn on 2-Step Verification under Security, then create one under App passwords. Gmail releases about 2.5 GB per day via IMAP, so a large mailbox takes several days; syncing continues on its own.
company_sync_hint_gmx: In GMX, allow IMAP access under Email → Settings → POP3/IMAP retrieval.
company_sync_hint_webde: In WEB.DE, allow IMAP access under Email → Settings → POP3/IMAP retrieval.
company_sync_hint_tonline: Use the email password from the Telekom customer center, not the login password.
company_sync_hint_other: Use the IMAP server of your previous provider, port 993 (or 143 with STARTTLS).
company_sync_finish_confirm: After this, nothing more will be fetched and the saved password will be deleted.
company_sync_finished_forward: So nothing gets lost, set up forwarding to {address} with your previous provider (in Gmail: Settings → Forwarding and POP/IMAP).
company_sync_finished_domain: If the address belongs to your own domain, point the MX record to this server instead.
company_m365_setup_hint: In the Microsoft Entra admin center, register an app, give it the application permissions Mail.Read, Contacts.Read, Calendars.Read and User.Read.All (optionally MailboxSettings.Read for the colors of Outlook categories), grant admin consent and create a client secret. Enter the values here; the secret is stored encrypted.
company_m365_hint: Emails with folders, contacts and events (including recurring ones) are imported; after that Kontext syncs every 15 minutes. Nothing is changed at Microsoft.
categories_dialog_hint: Colored labels on emails, several per email. In a shared mailbox all members see the same categories.
pwa_offline: No connection. New emails and changes will come through once the device is back online.
pwa_update: A new version of Kontext is available.
pwa_hint: Kontext can be installed like an app: its own window, an icon in the Start menu or on the Home Screen, an unread count on the icon, and sharing photos and files from other apps straight into a new email.
pwa_installed: Kontext is installed as an app on this device.
pwa_install_apple: On iPhone and iPad: in Safari, tap “Share”, then “Add to Home Screen”.
pwa_install_browser: In the browser menu, choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
pwa_mailto_hint: Clicking an email address on a web page will then open a new email in Kontext.
pwa_mailto_done: Your browser will now ask whether Kontext should open email links.
pwa_version_server: The server is already running {version}. Once it has loaded, “Reload” appears.
tasks_quick_add: Add task, e.g. “Call back Hoffmann tomorrow”
tasks_empty: No tasks. Create new ones above, or from an email with “Task”.
tasks_pick: Select a task on the left.
tasks_notes_placeholder: What needs to be done, what matters?
tasks_from_mail_link: Linked to this email and the conversation
chat_direct_none: None yet. Message someone with “New message”.
chat_pick: Select a channel or conversation on the left.
chat_unknown: This chat doesn’t exist, or you’re not a member.
chat_empty: No messages yet. Write the first one.
chat_mailbox_everyone: Everyone with access to the mailbox
chat_voice_denied: No microphone access. Please allow it in your browser settings.
chat_voice_unsupported: This browser can’t record voice messages.
chat_link: Link an email, task or contact
chat_link_with_documents: Link an email, task, contact or document
chat_card_elsewhere: Belongs to {owner}; can only be opened there
chat_discuss_placeholder: What needs to be sorted out? @ to mention people
chat_discuss_hint: The email stays where it is. In the chat it appears as a card; anyone who can see this mailbox can open it.
tasks_from_message_link: Linked to the message in chat
chat_leave_confirm: Leave {name}? You won't be able to see the history anymore.
chat_delete_channel_confirm: Delete {name} with all its messages, photos and files? This can't be undone.
chat_delete_message_confirm: Delete this message? Photos and files in it will be deleted too.
call_running: Call in progress · {count} on the call
call_no_device: No access to microphone or camera – please allow it in your browser.
call_other_active: You're already on a call. Hang up first, then join here.
call_confidential_locked: For a confidential call, first unlock your key – in the chat of this conversation.
meeting_waiting: The meeting hasn't started yet. Once someone from the company is here, you can join.
meeting_unavailable: Video meetings aren't set up on this server.
meeting_hint: With camera and microphone in the browser, no sign-in and no app.
phone_offline: The phone box isn't connected right now. Calls still ring on the desk phones.
phone_not_allowed: Telephony isn't enabled for you. You can change this in Company admin under Telephony.
phone_settings_hint: Kontext makes calls through a small phone box in the office that registers with the Fritzbox like an IP phone. Calls then also ring in Kontext, and you can make calls from Kontext.
phone_box_code_hint: Valid for 30 minutes. Enter it on the box at http://<box>:8089, or start the box like this:
phone_box_remove_confirm: Remove box “{name}”? Its call list will be deleted too.
phone_line_hint: In the Fritzbox, go to Telephony → Telephony devices → New device → “Telephone (with and without answering machine)” → LAN/WLAN (IP telephone) and create a device “Kontext”. Enter the username and password from there here and set which numbers it responds to.
phone_line_password_keep: Leave blank to keep the saved password
phone_ring_hint: These people hear incoming calls ring in Kontext, see the call list and can make calls from Kontext.
phone_callbacks_hint: A missed call creates a “Call back” task, due today. As soon as someone has spoken to the number – by calling back or because they called again – it's marked as done.
phone_sounds_hint: Announcements for voicemail, opening hours and menu. Speak directly into the microphone or upload an audio file (three minutes at most); Kontext converts it to the format the phone needs.
phone_mailbox_hint: If nobody answers, the box plays the announcement and records a message. It arrives as an email with the recording and appears under Phone with the call.
phone_hours_hint: Outside these hours nothing rings, neither in Kontext nor on the box: the caller hears the announcement and can leave a message if voicemail is on. The box decides on its own, even when Kontext is unreachable.
phone_forward: Also ring on a mobile phone
phone_forward_hint: The box calls the mobile phone through the Fritzbox; this needs a second free line. The display there usually shows your own number, not the caller's. With voicemail, the mobile phone has to ring before the voicemail picks up.
phone_lines_hint: Extensions: for each additional number in the Fritzbox, create another IP phone that responds only to that number, and enter here who it rings. Anyone on an extension also makes calls with it.
phone_held: On hold – the caller hears hold music
phone_desks_hint: Snom phones register with the box instead of the Fritzbox. They ring together with Kontext (a person's phone for their numbers, a shared one for the first number), reach each other via the short number, and can be called from Kontext and receive transferred calls.
phone_desk_provisioning: On the phone, enter under Advanced → Update → Settings URL:
phone_menu_hint: Before ringing, the caller hears an announcement (“For customer service, press 1 …”) and chooses with a key who gets rung or whether to go to voicemail. Without a key press, it rings as usual.
phone_block_done: {number} will be rejected from now on.
phone_blocklist_hint: The box rejects these numbers before anything rings anywhere. In the call list you can also do this with “Block”.
phone_blocklist_anonymous: Reject calls with a hidden number
phone_door: Someone is ringing at the door
phone_door_hint: The door intercom on the Fritzbox calls its phones via an internal number. When it calls the box, the chosen people are rung in Kontext, with “Open door” and “Talk”. In the Fritzbox, the door intercom must also call the IP phone “Kontext”.
phone_door_enabled: Ring the door intercom in Kontext
phone_fax_hint: One number on the box receives faxes. Each arrives as a PDF by email and appears with the call. For a dedicated fax number, create another IP phone in the Fritzbox for that number and enter it under “Other numbers”.
phone_sip_error: LiveKit SIP is unreachable ({error}). Calls in Kontext won't work until it's running (see Installation → Telephony).
settings_tab_bar_hint: Which apps appear in the bar at the bottom, on this device. All others are under “More”.
settings_threads_hint: One row per conversation, like Gmail; archiving and deleting then apply to the whole conversation in the folder. Off: every email on its own as it arrives – the conversation still shows up when you read it.
mail_unsent: Not sent – the email is back in Drafts.
mail_unsend_too_late: Too late – the email is already on its way.
mail_later_invalid: Please pick a time within the next 7 days.
settings_undo_hint: How long an email waits after “Send”; until then, “Undo” brings it back.
mail_scheduled_empty: Nothing scheduled. “Schedule send” is at the arrow next to “Send”.
snippets_mine_hint: Only for you. {first} and {full} are replaced with the recipient's name when inserted.
snippets_shared_hint: For everyone who works in this mailbox. {first} and {full} are replaced with the recipient's name.
snippets_body_example:
Hello {full},

thank you for your inquiry …
mail_snooze_invalid: Please pick a time in the future, no more than a year ahead.
mail_snoozed_empty: Nothing snoozed. With “w” or the clock above an email, you can set it aside until a chosen time.
tasks_remind_hint: Sent as a notification to the assignee – even when Kontext is closed.
tasks_from_mail_link_contact: Linked to this email, the conversation and {name}
tasks_from_mails_link: One task per email, linked to the email and the contact
chat_kept_for: Messages are kept for {time} – as set in Company admin.
chat_card_copy: Shared as a copy – read here
chat_copy_hint: A copy that was shared in the chat. Images from the internet are hidden.
chat_discuss_copy_hint: With text and attachments – readable even for everyone without access to this mailbox.
chat_discuss_copy_note: The copy stays in the chat even if the email is deleted later.
company_chat_hint: How long messages stay in team chat, including photos and files. Kontext deletes older ones automatically, which is good for privacy.
company_chat_warning: Messages older than {time} will be deleted when you save.
company_chat_confirm: Permanently delete messages older than {time} now?
chat_confidential_toggle_hint: Only members can read along, not even the admin. Each member needs their own key (Settings → Encryption). No search, no cards, notifications without text; anyone who joins later sees messages from then on.
chat_confidential_closed: Confidential message – unlock your key to read it.
chat_confidential_not_for_you: Confidential message from before you joined – not encrypted for you.
chat_confidential_forged: The signature doesn’t match the sender – be careful.
chat_confidential_unlock_hint: This conversation is confidential. Unlock your key to read and write – it stays unlocked until you reload Kontext.
chat_key_changed: {name} has a new key. Compare the fingerprint with {name} (by phone or in person) before you write anything confidential:
chat_go_confidential_confirm: Create a new, end-to-end encrypted conversation with the same members? What’s here stays here, unencrypted; each member needs their own key.
tasks_columns_hint: Rename, add, reorder. “Open” stays first and “Done” last; tasks in a deleted column move to “Open”.
sync_title: Tasks in Thunderbird and on your phone
sync_hint: Your boards show up there as task lists – My board and every shared mailbox. Whatever you check off or create there appears in Kontext right away, and vice versa.
sync_login: Sign in with your email address {user} and your password.
sync_thunderbird_1: In the calendar sidebar, choose “New Calendar …” → “On the Network”.
sync_thunderbird_2: Enter your username and the server address, then click “Find Calendars”.
sync_thunderbird_3: Check the task lists; they then appear under “Tasks”.
sync_android_1: Install DAVx⁵ and tasks.org or jtx Board.
sync_android_2: In DAVx⁵, choose “Login with URL and user name”, enter the server address and turn on the task lists.
sync_apple_1: Settings → Apps → Reminders → Accounts → Add Account → Other → Add CalDAV Account.
sync_apple_2: Server: {host}, plus your email address and password.
sync_two_factor: Signing in there doesn’t work yet with two-step verification, because these apps don’t ask for a code.
mail_unsubscribe_one_click: Kontext unsubscribes you from {sender} – no detour through a web page.
mail_unsubscribe_mail: Kontext sends an unsubscribe email to {address}.
mail_unsubscribe_web: The sender’s unsubscribe page opens in a new tab; confirm the unsubscribe there.
mail_unsubscribe_no_identity: No sender address for the unsubscribe email.
mail_images_blocked: Images from the internet are blocked.
mail_images_unconfirmed: Images blocked: the sender isn’t verified, even though you otherwise trust them.
images_hint: Images in emails tell the sender that you opened the email. That’s why Kontext only loads them on request – or right away for senders you trust and who are verified as genuine.
images_contacts: Always load for senders in my contacts
images_none: No senders yet. “Always from …” on an email adds one.
mail_receipt_asked: {name} is asking for a read receipt.
mail_invitation_outdated: Your calendar holds a newer version of this event.
mail_receipt_failed: The read receipt couldn’t be sent.
mail_receipt_waiting: Read receipt requested – none received yet.
mail_transport_tls_hint: This email arrived at your own mail server encrypted (TLS). It couldn’t be read in transit – on the servers before and here, it is readable.
mail_transport_plain_hint: This email arrived at your own mail server unencrypted; someone could have read it along the way.
security_hint: How secure emails to and from you are in transit: what the DNS records of your domains say and whether Kontext is reachable over HTTPS.
security_https_warn: Kontext isn’t reachable over HTTPS: sign-ins and content travel over the network unencrypted.
security_mx_missing: No MX record: emails to this domain won’t arrive.
security_spf_missing: Without SPF, others can more easily send emails in your name, and yours land in spam more often.
security_dmarc_missing: Without DMARC, other mail servers don’t know what to do with forged emails in your name.
security_dmarc_warn: DMARC is set to “p=none”: forged emails are only reported. After a few weeks without problems, switch to “quarantine”.
security_mta_sts_missing: Missing: other mail servers may deliver to you unencrypted if someone suppresses encryption. Stalwart shows the records under Domains → DNS records.
security_mta_sts_warn: Set to “testing”: problems are only reported. Once the reports are clean, switch to “enforce”.
security_tls_rpt_missing: Missing: you won’t find out when other servers couldn’t deliver encrypted.
security_dane_warn: The domain is signed with DNSSEC but has no TLSA record for the mail server. Stalwart shows the record.
security_dane_info: Only works with DNSSEC at your DNS provider. Optional; MTA-STS does almost the same.
security_disk: The server’s disk and the backups should be encrypted; this can’t be seen from here.
backup_hint: Every night the server backs up emails, calendars, contacts, chat and files, encrypted, to a location outside the server.
backup_missing: Control isn’t set up on the server. The backup still runs if it’s set up via cron; it can only be seen and controlled here after setup.
backup_stale: The server isn’t responding: changes and “Back up now” don’t reach it.
backup_storage_over: More than {gb} GB used: free storage will soon be full. Free up space with your provider or choose a larger plan.
backup_off: No automatic backup. Only “Back up now” will back up.
backup_pause: During the backup, the mail server is off for a few seconds. Incoming emails aren’t lost: senders deliver them again afterward.
pgp_own_hint: With your personal key (OpenPGP) you sign emails and read what was encrypted for you. It’s protected by a passphrase only you know – without it, not even Kontext can open it.
pgp_passphrase_hint: The passphrase protects your key; Kontext doesn’t know it. A sentence is easier to remember than a complicated word.
pgp_recovery_hint: This code gets you to your key if you forget the passphrase. Write it down or print it and keep it safe – without the passphrase and the code, the key is lost, and with it everything encrypted for it.
pgp_delete_confirm: Really delete the key? Emails encrypted for it can no longer be read afterward – unless you have it elsewhere.
pgp_known_hint: Public keys of your contacts, so you can write to them encrypted. Kontext picks them up from their emails (Autocrypt), looks them up on the internet or accepts them from you. Compare the fingerprint by phone when it matters.
pgp_known_none: None yet. They arrive with emails from people who encrypt, or you can look them up here.
pgp_key_changed: A different key than before – if in doubt, ask.
pgp_signed_invalid: The signature doesn’t match: the email was altered in transit or is forged.
pgp_signed_unknown: Signed – it can only be verified with the key of {sender}.
pgp_no_key: This email is encrypted. You can open it with your key – create it under Settings → Encryption or import it.
pgp_unlock_hint: This email is encrypted. Unlock your key to read it – it stays unlocked until you reload Kontext.
pgp_cannot_decrypt: This email can’t be opened with your key – it was encrypted for a different one.
pgp_send_on: Encrypted and signed (PGP), including the subject.
pgp_send_no_key: To encrypt, you need your own key (Settings → Encryption).
pgp_send_other_sender: Encryption only works from your own address.
pgp_send_missing: No key for {addresses} – look it up under Settings → Encryption.
pgp_unlock_send_hint: To sign, Kontext needs your key. It stays unlocked until you reload Kontext.
pgp_send_draft_hint: While encryption is on, Kontext doesn’t save a draft on the server.
sign_on_smime: Signed with your S/MIME certificate, not encrypted – anyone can read it and verify that it comes from you.
sign_on_pgp: Signed with your PGP key, not encrypted – anyone with your key can verify that it comes from you.
sign_no_key: To sign, you need your own key or a certificate for this address (Settings → Encryption).
mail_forward_encrypted_closed: This email is encrypted: open it first (unlock your key), then it can be forwarded with its content and attachments.
secure_note_link: Confidential: via link with code – no undo period.
secure_link_days: How long the link is valid
smime_own_hint: Some agencies, law firms and corporations encrypt with S/MIME instead of PGP. For that you need a certificate from a certificate authority, as a .p12 file with a password. Kontext stores the file as is – it can only be opened with the password.
smime_import_hint: The .p12 or .pfx file with your key, and its password.
smime_wrong_password: The password is incorrect, or the file contains no key.
smime_delete_confirm: Really delete the certificate? Emails encrypted with it can no longer be read afterward – unless you still have the .p12 file.
smime_known_hint: When a signed S/MIME email arrives, Kontext remembers the sender’s certificate – then you can reply to them encrypted. Or add one from a file.
smime_known_none: None yet. They arrive with signed emails.
smime_cert_changed: A different certificate than before – if in doubt, ask.
smime_lookup_none: No certificate is published in DNS for {email} (or the response wasn’t signed).
smime_signed_checked: Signed by {sender} – confirmed by {issuer}, not revoked
smime_signed_revoked: The certificate of {sender} has been revoked – don’t trust the signature.
smime_signed_expired: Signed by {sender}, but the certificate (or its authority) has expired.
smime_signed_not_for_mail: Signed by {sender} with a certificate that isn’t meant for email.
smime_signed_unknown_ca: Signed by {sender} – issued by {issuer}, an authority Kontext doesn’t recognize.
smime_signed_unsupported: Signed by {sender} – with a method (EC key) that Kontext can’t verify yet.
smime_signed_self: Signed by {sender} – self-issued certificate, nobody vouches for it.
smime_signed_other: Signed by {signer}, not by the sender {sender} – be careful.
smime_no_cert: This email is encrypted with S/MIME. You can open it with your certificate – import it under Settings → Encryption.
smime_unlock_hint: This email is encrypted with S/MIME. Enter your certificate’s password – it stays open until you reload Kontext.
smime_cannot_decrypt: This email can’t be opened with your certificate – it was encrypted for a different one.
smime_auth_enveloped: This email is encrypted with a method (AuthEnvelopedData) that Kontext can’t open yet.
smime_send_on: Encrypted and signed (S/MIME), including the subject.
smime_unlock_send_hint: To sign, Kontext needs your certificate. It stays open until you reload Kontext.
secure_codes_hint: Give each recipient their code by other means – by phone or text message, not by email. Kontext shows it only now; you can get a new one under “Sent confidentially”.
secure_page_code_hint: Please enter the access code you received from {sender} – for example by phone or text message.
secure_page_footer: The message is stored encrypted on the sender’s server and only becomes readable here in your browser.
secure_wrong_code: The code is incorrect. {left} attempts left.
secure_locked: Too many wrong attempts: the message is locked. Please ask the sender for a new code.
secure_expired: This message has expired. Please ask the sender whether they can send it again.
secure_cannot_open: The message couldn’t be opened. Check that the link is complete.
secure_link_broken: The link is incomplete – the part after the # is missing. Please open it directly from the email.
secure_gone: This message no longer exists: it has expired or was withdrawn.
secure_reply_too_large: The files together are larger than 20 MB.
secure_reply_failed: The reply couldn’t be sent. Please try again.
secure_list_hint: What you’ve sent confidentially by link: opened, replied to, expired.
secure_list_empty: Nothing yet. Send an email with “Send confidentially” to someone without a key.
secure_pick: Select a message on the left.
secure_remove_confirm: Withdraw the message to {to}? The link will no longer open anything afterward.
secure_cannot_read: The message can’t be opened with your key.
external_hint: Gmail, GMX, WEB.DE and others in Kontext: new emails arrive every two minutes, the address is available as a sender when you write, and replies go from the address the email was sent to. Kontext leads: read status, moving and deleting stay in Kontext; everything at the provider stays as it is.
external_name_hint: Leave empty to use your name.
external_import_existing: Also import the emails currently in the provider’s inbox
external_hint_other: The provider’s IMAP server (port 993, or 143 with STARTTLS) and SMTP server (port 465, or 587 with STARTTLS).
external_remove_confirm: Kontext will then stop fetching and no longer send as this address. The fetched emails stay.
external_phones: Your phone and email app also see the fetched emails; sending as this address only works in Kontext.
external_no_later: Emails sent through another mailbox go out immediately; “Send later” isn’t available with them yet.
external_no_encrypt: Encrypting and signing aren’t available yet for another mailbox.
external_refused: Sent – but the provider rejected these recipients: {addresses}
phone_recording_hint: Whoever is on the phone can record the call in the call window. The recording is then attached to the call. Recording a call is only allowed with the other party’s consent (§ 201 StGB): before recording, the box plays the selected announcement, for example “This call is being recorded”.
documents_missing: Documents isn’t set up on this server.
documents_shared_failed: The file is linked but not shared with everyone: {message}
agents_hint: Through MCP (Model Context Protocol), an AI agent such as Claude works with Kontext: it looks up customers, emails, events and tasks and, on request, creates drafts, events, contacts and tasks – with your permissions.
agents_key_once: The key is only visible now. Copy it into your agent; anyone who has it can read what you’re allowed to read.
agents_other_clients: Other agents: enter the MCP address (Streamable HTTP) and send the key as the header “Authorization: Bearer …”.
agents_revoke_question: Disconnect “{name}”? The agent will no longer be able to access Kontext afterward.
agents_safety: An agent never sends or deletes anything on its own: it saves replies as drafts, which you review in Kontext and send. Emails come from outside and can slip false instructions to an agent – check what it creates.
agents_key_hint: For Claude Code, scripts and agents without a browser sign-in: a key you enter there.
agents_write_hint: Drafts, events, contacts and tasks. Unchecked, the agent can only read.
agents_oauth_hint: Claude (app, desktop, claude.ai) and other agents with sign-in: add the address as a custom connector. Kontext then asks for your password in the browser and then for what the agent may do.
agent_consent_read: read customers, emails, events and tasks, with your permissions
agent_consent_never: never send or delete on its own
agent_consent_password: Your password to confirm. You can disconnect access at any time under Settings → AI agents.
agent_consent_invalid: This page belongs to a sign-in from an AI agent. Please reconnect there.
agent_consent_signed_out: You’re no longer signed in. Please reconnect in the agent.
invitation_answer_elsewhere: You can also reply in your calendar app.
rsvp_told: {name} sees your response in the calendar.
rsvp_invalid: This link is invalid or has expired.
rsvp_not_invited: You’re no longer invited to this event.
rsvp_too_many: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute.
settings_swipe_hint: On the phone: swipe an email to the side. Applies to this device.
calendar_default_reminder_hint: The reminder a new appointment in this calendar gets; it can be changed on the appointment. It applies to you. In a shared calendar, the owner's applies otherwise.
mail_external_ask_hint: This mail also goes to recipients outside the company:
mail_external_ask_invitation: The invitation also goes to attendees outside the company:
company_external_intro: Mail from outside the company carries the mark “External” in the list and when reading. Before a mail or an invitation goes to external recipients, Kontext asks once.
company_external_own: The own domains count as internal: {domains}
company_external_partners_hint: One domain per line, e.g. tax-office-smith.com. Addresses of these domains (and their subdomains) count as internal.
